title: State Commission's Obligation to Furnish Information to the State Government

content.scenario: The State Government requests the State Commission to provide information on consumer disputes handled by the Commission. The Commission must respond to the request.
content.outcome: The State Commission must furnish information to the State Government as per sub-section (5) of section 70 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, in the form prescribed under the rules.

user_queries: What information must the State Commission furnish to the State Government?
In what form must the State Commission provide information to the State Government?
Can the State Commission refuse to furnish information to the State Government?
